propositions: Rebar gates currently lack expressible per-pass model tier configuration and silently fail to downgrade verifiers when operators specify non-default provider models
The single-scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL knob cannot express per-tier mappings; pass-1 ladder and verifier paths resolve to split-brain provider routing (direct anthropic vs configured provider)
Deep recursive merging of config tables and wholesale array replacement via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointer must preserve sibling keys and allow explicit disablement of fallback chains
Three reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) in workflow YAML model strings must resolve through one function at exactly three call sites without creating module-level import cycles
Per-pass model resolution across multiple providers must survive cross-provider boundaries with class-based dispatch while correctly resolving provider-specific capabilities like prompt_cache_style
